newsitem.title: USA: National Data files for up to $125 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: National Data files for up to $125 mln notes.

text.p: National Data Corp said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $125 million in convertible subordinated notes due October, 2003.
The Atlanta, Ga.-based company said the underwriters have been granted an over-allotment of up to $18,750,000 in additional prinicipal amount of notes.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co and Salomon Brothers, the company said.

National Data intends to use about $62 million of the net proceeds to repay outstanding indebtedness. The balance will be added to the company's working capital to be available for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
